ms.lead: Mastery progress for Warframes, weapons, companions and more. Tick the box on the left to record it as mastered (saved on this PC).
ms.novault.nodata: Not available until the drop tables and all source data are downloaded (get them with Update data)
ms.vaulted.tip: Some parts only come from vaulted relics, so this can't be built right now
ms.src.nodata: Sources can't be checked because the drop tables are missing. Run Update data.
ms.src.none: No sources in the drop tables, clan research and similar data (items from the Market, Baro and so on are not listed; Syndicates, quest rewards and vendors appear if Export Plus is also fetched in Update data).
ms.note: Kitguns count by chamber (primary and secondary versions separately), Zaws by strike, Amps by prism plus Sirocco, MOAs and Hounds by head (model), and K-Drives by board. Excalibur Prime, Skana Prime and Lato Prime are shown and counted under "Founder" only when "Founder" is checked. "Hide unobtainable" hides items that can't be built right now because some parts only come from vaulted relics (relics that drop nowhere in the current drop tables); they are marked "Vaulted". Relics that Varzia offers during the current Prime Resurgence count as obtainable. "Hide Prime" and "Hide unobtainable" only remove items from the list, bulk changes and CSV; they still count toward the totals and Mastery XP. The "Source" column shows the kinds of sources for the item and its parts. Click a row to open where to get it below that row (the item itself and each of its parts; only what is in the drop tables, clan research, Simaris and similar data, without event-only sources). The Plexus and the Amp itself are under "Other". Mastery XP is the value up to max rank (200 per rank for Warframes, companions, sentinels, MOAs/Hounds, Archwings, Necramechs, K-Drives and the Plexus; 100 for weapons. Kuva, Tenet, Coda and similar weapons and Necramechs go to rank 40).
